goal161tAuditIntake: GREEN_ACCEPTABLE_CANDIDATE_AT_C1BD0B7A; recorded without changing RC services.
runtimeSimulatorVersusPlayerBoundary: RuntimeSimulatorPageControl remains the technical command console; GeneratedCampaignSessionService owns player orchestration over IUnifiedGameRuntimeService.
campaignSessionTruth: GeneratedGameplaySaveValidator.CaptureProjectTruth supplies strict source, TRAVEL_CURRENT, package, authoring, world and binding truth captured at Start/Load/Migrate.
staleProjectDetection: Every Execute recaptures GeneratedGameplaySaveProjectTruth and compares identity/world/package/composition/authoring before dispatch.
contextProjection: GeneratedCampaignProjectionService projects GamePackageDefinition plus UnifiedRuntimeSession to human labels; raw values remain TechnicalDetails.
generatedRegionContentBinding: GeneratedWorldRegionMapBindingService bindings and GeneratedContent provenance select current map/region activity.
actionPlanningAndDispatch: GeneratedCampaignActionPlanner maps an opaque action token to existing PlayerCommand or GameRuntimeCommand only.
dialogueFlow: Interact/OpenDialogue then ChooseDialogueOption/CloseDialogue, with package node choices as labels.
encounterFlow: StartEncounter, BasicAttack/UseAbility, EndTurn and bounded RunCurrentTurnAi use current runtime participants.
questObjectiveFlow: Causal gameplay commands may issue one RefreshQuestObjectives; completion uses CompleteQuest only.
travelFlow: Interact remains the map runtime route and MapChanged is projected from returned events.
saveLoadMigrationFlow: GeneratedGameplaySaveService exact load and GeneratedGameplaySaveMigrationService explicit preview/apply are consumed without Runtime.Start on Continue.
sessionLifetimeAcrossNavigation: Singleton GeneratedCampaignSessionService retains only same-project current session.
projectsBuildAndPlay: ProjectsPageControl calls BuildAndQualify once when stale and requests generated-campaign-player through typed navigation.
winFormsNavigation: IEditorPageNavigationService event is handled by MainForm against IEditorPageRegistry.
uiLayout: Campaign page uses map/context/HUD panels with scrolling action content and collapsed technical details.
failureStateMatrix: NO_PROJECT, PROJECT_NOT_GENERATED, PROJECT_NOT_READY, READY, ACTIVE, STALE_PROJECT, SAVE_MIGRATION_REQUIRED and FAILED are projected with diagnostics.
legacyCompatibility: Non-generated projects are unavailable to campaign player; Runtime Simulator/raw snapshot behavior is not modified.
nonGoals: No Runtime, GamePackage, generated source/save/migration, Unity or standalone implementation mutation.
testInventory: Goal162 planned truth, projection, action, save/migration, navigation and UI tests; focused regressions run after implementation.
